points.description: States that the design flood is the flood (flood magnitude/discharge) adopted for the design of structures (e.g. hydraulic structures such as dams, spillways, bridges, culverts).
points.partial_credit: 1 mark if the idea is vague or incomplete, e.g. only 'a flood' or 'maximum flood' without linking it to design/adoption for structures, or the link to design is stated but the term flood/discharge is imprecise.

rubric.notes: Full marks (2) for saying the design flood is the flood (or peak discharge) that is adopted/chosen for designing structures; other wording and examples of structures are fine. Give 1 mark if the answer is vague or halfway, e.g. just 'the largest flood' or 'a flood used in design' without the idea of adoption for structures, or has a minor error. Give 0 for wrong or unrelated definitions.
